login.title: Operator sign in
login.subtitle: Restricted area. All access attempts are logged.
login.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.setupHelp: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
login.expired: Your session ended after inactivity. Please sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What is happening on the sportsbook right now.
dashboard.reconBad: {count, plural, one {# mismatch} other {# mismatches}} — see audit log

common2.reasonRequired: Please give a reason (at least 3 characters).

charts.paymentsLabel: Deposits and withdrawals paid per day

users.title: Players
users.description: Find a player by name, email or phone to view, edit, credit or suspend them.

stats.openTickets: {count, plural, one {# open ticket} other {# open tickets}}

users.suspendHelp: The player is logged out everywhere and cannot log in or bet until activated. Open bets stay as they are.
users.activateHelp: The player can log in and bet again.

limits.help: Applies at once. The player’s own limits still apply; the strictest wins.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.description: Add or remove RON credit with a reason, approve large amounts and follow every movement.

approvals.emptyHelp: Credits and debits above the approval threshold appear here for a second admin.
approvals.ownRequest: Your request: another admin must approve it

adjust.title: Add or remove credit
adjust.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than 0 (e.g. 50 or 12,50).
adjust.negative: The balance cannot go below zero; this debit will be refused.
adjust.approvalNote: Amounts above the approval threshold wait for a second admin before they are applied.
adjust.queued: Above the threshold: sent for a second admin’s approval
adjust.pickHint: Type at least 2 characters to search.

requests.ownFirst: You gave the first approval; another admin must give the second.
requests.emptyPending: Nothing waiting. New deposit and withdrawal requests from players appear here.

confirm.approveDepositHelp: Only confirm once the money from {name} is in our account (or the shop has confirmed the cash). The balance is credited at once.
confirm.approveWithdrawalHelp: Only confirm once {name} has been paid (transfer sent or cash handed over). The held amount leaves the wallet.
confirm.rejectHelp: {name} sees your reason. A withdrawal’s held amount goes back to the balance.

toast.approved: Done: the wallet is updated and the player notified
toast.firstApproval: First approval saved; a second Finance admin must confirm
toast.rejected: Request rejected; the player is notified

bets.title: Bets
bets.description: Every ticket: live and open bets, settled results and cash outs.

sportsbook.title: Sportsbook
sportsbook.description: Turn leagues and markets on or off, suspend matches and set the betting limits.

leagues.help: A disabled league disappears from the site and takes no bets. ★ marks a top league.
leagues.topOff: {name} is no longer a top league

markets.help: Switching a market type off hides it everywhere and refuses new bets on it.
markets.open: {count, plural, =0 {No open markets} one {# open market} other {# open markets}}

events.resumeHelp: Bets are accepted again on every open market of this match.
events.suspendHelp: No new bets are accepted on this match until you resume it. Placed bets are not affected.

eventMarkets.priceHelp: This price is kept until you hand it back to automatic pricing; players see the change immediately.
eventMarkets.autoHelp: Automatic pricing takes this selection back over at the next refresh.
eventMarkets.none: No markets for this match yet.
eventMarkets.suspendHelp: The market stays visible but locked. Feed updates will not reopen it.
eventMarkets.resumeHelp: The market reopens (unless the feed has it suspended).
eventMarkets.hideHelp: The market disappears from the site and takes no bets.
eventMarkets.showHelp: The market is shown on the site again.

keys.feed_stallSeconds: Suspend live markets after feed silence of

help.betting_maxPayoutBani: Cap on what one ticket can win
help.betting_liveDelayMs: Live bets are re-checked after this wait
help.cashout_enabled: Turn the cash out offer on or off for everyone
help.cashout_marginBps: Kept by the house on a cash out
help.wallet_approvalThresholdBani: Larger credits and debits need a second admin
help.payments_bankTransferEnabled: Offer bank transfers for deposits and withdrawals
help.wallet_minDepositBani: Smallest deposit a player can request
help.wallet_minWithdrawalBani: Smallest withdrawal a player can request

settle.title: Settle {match}
settle.help: Enter the final result. {tickets, plural, one {# open bet is} other {# open bets are}} graded and paid at once.
settle.cancelHelp: The match is called off: every open bet on it is voided and the stakes are refunded.
settle.halfTimeError: The half-time score cannot be higher than the full-time score.
settle.done: Settled: {tickets, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}, {paid} paid
settle.playersHelp: Tick the players who played and enter their goals and shots. Bets on players left unticked are void (stake back).
settle.resettleHelp: Enter the corrected result. Every bet on this match is graded again: extra winnings are paid, winnings no longer due are taken back. If a player no longer has that money, nothing changes.
settle.resettled: Corrected: {tickets, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} changed, {credited} paid, {debited} taken back

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Players, stakes, payouts and risk for a period.
reports.range: {from} – {to}. Money figures come from the wallet ledger.

payments.title: Deposits & withdrawals
payments.rejected: {count, plural, one {# rejected} other {# rejected}} in this period

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: Every admin action, wallet change, betting event and system event. Entries can never be edited or deleted.
audit.search: Admin email, entity id or action…

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-factor authentication and where you are signed in.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.emailHelp: Email and role are changed by a Super admin.

password.title: Password
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
password.note: Your other devices will be signed out.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.help: Got a new phone? Move your codes to it here. You need a code from the current app first.
totp.step1: Step 1 of 2: enter a code from your current authenticator app.
totp.step2: Step 2 of 2: scan this QR code with the new phone, then enter the code it shows.
totp.changed: Two-factor moved to the new phone. Other devices were signed out.

sessions.title: Signed in on
sessions.endOthers: Sign out {count, plural, one {the other device} other {# other devices}}

admins.title: Admin users
admins.description: Who can access the back office and what each person can do. Only Super admins see this page.
admins.forbiddenHelp: Ask a Super admin to create or change admin accounts.

roleHelp.OPERATOR: Players, bets and sportsbook settings (leagues, markets, matches, betting limits).
roleHelp.FINANCE: Money: add/remove credit, approvals, the approval threshold.

create.title: Add an admin
create.help: They get a temporary password and set up two-factor with a QR code at their first login.

edit.title: Edit admin
edit.emailHelp: Changing the email or role signs them out everywhere.
edit.ownRole: You cannot change your own role.

confirm.suspendHelp: They are signed out at once and cannot log in until activated.
confirm.activateHelp: They can log in again (a lockout is cleared too).
confirm.passwordHelp: A new temporary password is shown once; they are signed out everywhere.
confirm.totpHelp: Their authenticator is unlinked; they scan a new QR code at the next login. Use this when a phone is lost.

temp.title: Temporary password
temp.once: This password is shown only now. Copy it and send it to the admin through a secure channel.
temp.next: At their next login they set up two-factor with a QR code, then can change this password under My account.

toast.totpReset: Two-factor reset: QR at next login

dataProvider.title: Data provider
dataProvider.description: Where matches, live scores and results come from, the API key and how many calls the site may use.
dataProvider.forbiddenHelp: Ask a Super admin to change the data provider or its API key.
dataProvider.syncStarted: Loading leagues and fixtures in the background…
dataProvider.saved: Saved. The site switches within a few seconds; no restart needed.

providers.api-football_help: Real fixtures, live scores and results (api-sports.io)
providers.mock_help: Simulated matches, always some live; no API calls

stats.fromEnv: From the server settings (.env) until saved here
stats.feedStale: Older than {limit} s: live matches are suspended
stats.mockNoCalls: Demo data uses no API calls

form.title: Settings
form.keyHelp: Stored encrypted; only the last 4 characters are ever shown.
form.dailyBudgetHelp: Keep a few below the plan limit (free plan: 100).

errors.key: Paste a valid API key (at least 10 characters).
errors.removeWhileActive: Switch to Demo data before removing the key, or replace it.
errors.budget: Calls per day must be at least 10 and calls per minute at least 1.

test.ok: Key works · plan {plan} · {used} of {limit} calls used today

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.help: Which competitions to load from API-Football. Fewer leagues use fewer calls.
leagues.note: Leagues switched off here disappear from the site at the next sync; you can still hide one temporarily under Sportsbook → Leagues.

confirm.title: Save data provider settings?
confirm.help: The API and the worker pick up the change within seconds.
confirm.switch: The site switches from {from} to {to}. Matches from {from} are hidden after the next sync (use “Load fixtures now”).

email.title: Email
email.description: The mail server used for outgoing email such as password resets.
email.forbiddenHelp: Only a Super admin can see or change the email settings.
email.noneWarning: No mail server is set up: password-reset emails are only written to the server log. Enter your SMTP details below.

stats.fromEnv: From the server file (SMTP_URL) until you save here

form.title: SMTP server
form.enabledHelp: Off: emails are only written to the log (nothing is sent).
form.usernameHelp: Usually your full email address or the API user from your provider. Leave empty if the server needs no login.
form.passwordHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again. To change it, choose Replace.

security.tls_help: Encrypted from the start, usually port 465
security.none_help: Unencrypted, only for a local relay

errors.password: Enter the password for this username.
errors.testTo: Enter the address to send the test email to.

test.title: Send a test email
test.help: Uses the settings in the form, even before you save them. Nothing is stored.
test.ok: Sent to {to}. Check the inbox (and the spam folder).

tips.title: Tips
tips.providers: Any provider with SMTP works: Amazon SES, Postmark, Mailgun, SendGrid, Brevo, or your own mail server.
tips.domain: Use a sender address on your own domain and set up SPF, DKIM and DMARC with your provider, or emails may land in spam.

confirm.title: Save email settings?
confirm.help: The new settings are used for the next email, without a restart.
